description: EKA managed-metadata term sets (term store taxonomy). Declarative, tenant-neutral. Term labels and ids are placeholders to be assigned on import into the target tenant term store. Mirrors docs/information-arch/information-architecture.md section 3. AS2885 (transmission) and AS4645 (distribution) are kept distinct.

termSets.name: Asset Type
termSets.description: Keeps transmission and distribution assets distinct.

termSets.name: Discipline
termSets.description: Engineering discipline for filtering and grounding.

termSets.name: Capability
termSets.description: Maps to the nine program capability-area shorthands.

terms.label: Draft
terms.description: Working draft / newly generated (DRAFT — pending engineering review).

terms.label: Approved

termSets.name: Standard Reference
termSets.description: Governing-standard reference labels ONLY. These never encode clause text, acceptance criteria, or requirements. AS2885 (transmission) and AS4645 (distribution) kept distinct. Actual clause/section content comes only from a licensed source in StandardsExtracts (subject to OQ-1).
